objective: Test canonical ClariFin_OS mutation cache correctness and invalidation

test_scenarios.description: Same source, environment, configuration, mutation identity should yield CACHE HIT
test_scenarios.test_method: Run same campaign twice with identical parameters
test_scenarios.expected_result: Second run should reuse cache (faster execution)
test_scenarios.notes: Cache reuse works when parameters are identical

test_scenarios.test_method: Modify source file, run campaign, verify cache invalidated
test_scenarios.expected_result: Cache should be invalidated and rebuilt
test_scenarios.notes: Cache validation checks repository_sha and invalidates on mismatch

test_scenarios.description: Test modification should trigger appropriate invalidation
test_scenarios.test_method: Modify test file, run campaign, verify cache handling
test_scenarios.expected_result: Cache should be invalidated according to dependency semantics

evidence.invalidation_trigger: config_hash mismatch (if test selection changes config)

test_scenarios.notes: Test modifications that affect config selection will invalidate cache

test_scenarios.description: Dependency modification should trigger appropriate invalidation
test_scenarios.test_method: Modify dependency, run campaign, verify cache handling
test_scenarios.expected_result: Cache should be invalidated according to dependency semantics
test_scenarios.notes: Dependency modifications that affect config will invalidate cache

test_scenarios.description: Mutation configuration modification should invalidate cache
test_scenarios.test_method: Change mutmut configuration, run campaign, verify cache invalidated
test_scenarios.notes: Config hash is computed from backend/pyproject.toml, changes invalidate cache

test_scenarios.description: Backend version modification should invalidate cache where result semantics can differ
test_scenarios.test_method: Change mutmut version, run campaign, verify cache handling
test_scenarios.expected_result: Cache should be invalidated for version changes
test_scenarios.notes: mutmut_version is pinned to 3.7.0, any change will invalidate cache

test_scenarios.description: Verification profile modification should trigger appropriate invalidation
test_scenarios.test_method: Change verification profile, run campaign, verify cache handling
test_scenarios.expected_result: Cache should be invalidated according to dependency semantics
test_scenarios.notes: Profile changes that affect mutation config will invalidate cache

stale_evidence_prevention.no_cache_override: If no_cache=True, cache is always removed regardless of validation

cache_correctness_tests.description: Verify cache reuse produces identical results
cache_correctness_tests.method: Run same campaign twice, compare results
cache_correctness_tests.notes: Cache reuse produces identical mutation counts and scores

cache_correctness_tests.method: Modify source, run campaign, verify fresh execution
cache_correctness_tests.setup: Modify any source file in account_engine
cache_correctness_tests.expected: Cache should be invalidated, fresh mutation generation
cache_correctness_tests.notes: Cache validation will detect repository_sha change and invalidate

cache_correctness_tests.method: Run account_engine twice with cache enabled (no --no-cache), compare results
cache_correctness_tests.notes: Identical results across two runs; cache provenance file present at backend/.mutmut-cache/provenance.json

cache_correctness_tests.description: Verify --no-cache forces fresh execution with same results
cache_correctness_tests.method: Run account_engine with --no-cache after a cached run
cache_correctness_tests.notes: Fresh execution produces identical counts, confirming the runner is deterministic regardless of cache state

recommendations: Cache architecture is robust and properly validated
No stale evidence can silently become authoritative
